title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered Anime's New Video Unveils FLOW's Opening Song, June 25 Debut
content: The staff for the anime of Kentarou 's From Overshadowed to Overpowered ( Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musō: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Bōkenroku or The Failed Sage's Academy Domination ) manga presented its main promotional video and a key visual on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Sound Euphonium Final Movie Part 2 Unveils Main Trailer, Final Key Visual
content: Sound Euphonium Final Movie Part 2 unveiled its main trailer and final key visual on Saturday. The movie is set to premiere this coming September 11 in Japanese theaters. Studio Kyoto Animation is in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Theme Song, July 8 Premiere
content: The Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 revealed a new visual along with the opening and ending theme song artists and a July 8 premiere date. MYTH & ROID will sing the opening song “Why? RED induction” while the ending song “Weiter! Weiter!” is performed by Tanya Degurechaff (voiced by Aoi Yuki).
author: Anime Corner

title: Tomica & Tom TV Anime Shorts Get 2nd Season on July 5 With Song by May J.
content: Tomica & Tom (Tomica to Tomu) , the television anime shorts based on Tsumupapa's picture books and Takara Tomy 's Tomica line of die-cast car toys, will have a second season premiering on July 5. The shorts will play within the children's variety program Tomipla World Nori Nori Times!!
author: ANN

title: Sound! Euphonium, The Final Movie Part 2 Streams Full English-Subtitled Trailer
content: The staff for Sound! Euphonium, The Final Movie Part 2 ( Saishū Gakushō Hibike! Euphonium Kōhen ), the final part in the Sound! Euphonium , The Final Movie project , began streaming its full trailer with English subtitles and presented its "final key visual" on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Saga of Tanya the Evil II Unveils Theme Song Artists, July 8 Debut, Mini Anime
content: Kadokawa unveiled on Saturday the new visual, theme songs' artists, July 8 premiere, and a mini anime for Saga of Tanya the Evil II ( Yōjo Senki II) , the second season based on author Carlo Zen and illustrator Shinobu Shinotsuki 's light novel series.

title: Steins;Gate Re:Boot Game's Trailer Previews 'Gamma Worldline' Route
content: Spike Chunsoft revealed a new trailer on Saturday for its release of MAGES. ' Steins;Gate Re:Boot game . The trailer previews a new story route created for the game, the "Gamma Worldline" story.
